                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-f67534b4=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-f67534b4=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ca1280dedfdf4382be2f57b8f738fd03~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1795403276&amp;x-signature=fQb6kHj4kgaxW%2B1AvsZDX8IY8WA%3D" alt="AI 流式输出都用 SSE，什么时候必须换 WebSocket？" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>上个月，我们的 <code>AI</code> 客服助手全量上线，第三天运维就找上门：问答接口的 <code>QPS</code> 莫名翻了一倍，客服还收到一堆投诉，说回答<strong>半天不吐字</strong>，用户以为卡死，点一次发一次，重试越点越多。</p>
<p>查了一圈，根因不在大模型，而在传输层。<code>Nginx</code> 默认把流式响应缓冲起来攒一波再吐，首字硬生生拖到 8 秒；前端用的还是最省事的裸 <code>EventSource</code>，断了不报错、慢了不提示，用户只能靠狂点续命。重试流量反过来又压垮网关，恶性循环。</p>
<p>这就是流式场景最真实的场景：模型没问题，管子先爆了。今天就把这根管子讲透，什么时候 <code>SSE</code> 够用，什么时候必须换 <code>WebSocket</code>，以及各自的坑怎么填。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-0">裸 <code>EventSource</code> 和 <code>WebSocket</code></h3>
<p>出问题后，组里出现两种声音。一种说 <code>EventSource</code> 一行代码就能跑，别折腾；另一种说干脆全量切 <code>WebSocket</code>，一劳永逸。这两条路我都踩过，都有坑，只是结果不同。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-1">裸 <code>EventSource</code> 的坑在哪？</h4>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/113d527185fc4bb6a0ddde2ecb720837~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1795403276&amp;x-signature=AbBUi4WDoaGpXN8ulzAlD2Wy5nY%3D" alt="原生 EventSource 三大陷阱.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><code>EventSource</code> 的 <code>API</code> 是只读的：只支持 <code>GET</code>，不支持自定义请求头。<code>token</code> 只能拼在 <code>URL</code> 上，网关日志、<code>CDN</code> 日志、浏览器历史全是明文，安全评审直接打回。断线重连看似自动，实则裸奔：没有服务端配合回放 <code>Last-Event-ID</code>，重连后要么丢消息，要么从头发完整流，用户会看到回答闪一下重打一遍。更隐蔽的是超时，<code>Nginx</code> 默认 <code>proxy_buffering on</code>，流式响应会被攒批，首字时间完全不可控。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-2"><code>WebSocket</code> 的坑呢？</h4>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/4801aae633cf4e2d99a03ffe9e4afee0~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1795403276&amp;x-signature=mPDtbUwrlPhuutRAuz%2B%2FH%2F%2FWT00%3D" alt="WebSocket长连接与重连成本.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><code>WebSocket</code> 是长连接，网关要为每个连接维持状态，连接数直接变成成本。我们的客服页是低频使用的页面，用户问完就关，为这种<strong>低频、单向、下行主导</strong>的流量维持全双工连接，实例数要翻几倍。移动端更惨，切后台、锁屏、进电梯，连接一断就得整套重连、重鉴权、重订阅，心跳和退避策略全要自己写。</p>
<p>结论很清晰了👉：<strong>下行主导、低频、低延迟要求不极致，用 <code>SSE</code>；双向实时、高频上行、需要服务端主动推且客户端也要频繁说话，才上 <code>WebSocket</code></strong>。比如多轮问答、摘要生成是 <code>SSE</code> 的主场；协作编辑、语音对讲、实时游戏状态同步，才是 <code>WebSocket</code> 的主场。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">生产级的 <code>SSE</code> 客户端长什么样</h3>
<p>先看大多数人写的版本，十五分钟能跑，三个月后必返工：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 这个能跑，但迟早返工</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">streamAnswer</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, onToken: (t: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> es = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EventSource</span>(url); <span class="hljs-comment">// token 只能拼 URL，GET 裸奔</span>
  es.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onToken</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>);
  es.<span class="hljs-property">onerror</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    es.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 断了就关，没有重连，没有续接</span>
  };
}
</code></pre>
<p>生产级版本必须同时解决四件事：<code>POST + token</code> 请求头鉴权、可取消、断线按 <code>Last-Event-ID</code> 续接、退避重试。直接上代码：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 真正的 fetch + ReadableStream 的生产级 SSE 客户端</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">SSEMessage</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">event</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">StreamOptions</span> {
  headers?: <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt;;
  lastEventId?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  maxRetries?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  baseDelayMs?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  signal?: <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortSignal</span>;
  onMessage?: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">msg: SSEMessage</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  onDone?: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">parseSSEBlock</span>(<span class="hljs-params">block: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">SSEMessage</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> event = <span class="hljs-string">'message'</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">dataLines</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>[] = [];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> line <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> block.<span class="hljs-title function_">split</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'\n'</span>)) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (line.<span class="hljs-title function_">startsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'id:'</span>)) id = line.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">trim</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (line.<span class="hljs-title function_">startsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'event:'</span>)) event = line.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">6</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">trim</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (line.<span class="hljs-title function_">startsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'data:'</span>)) dataLines.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(line.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">5</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">trimStart</span>());
    <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (line.<span class="hljs-title function_">startsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">':'</span>)) <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 服务端心跳注释行</span>
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (dataLines.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span> &amp;&amp; id === <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { id, event, <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: dataLines.<span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'\n'</span>) };
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span>(<span class="hljs-params">ms: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, signal?: AbortSignal</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">resolve, reject</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> timer = <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      signal?.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'abort'</span>, onAbort);
      <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>();
    }, ms);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onAbort</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(timer);
      <span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DOMException</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aborted'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>));
    };
    signal?.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'abort'</span>, onAbort, { <span class="hljs-attr">once</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
  });
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">streamSSE</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, body: <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>, options: StreamOptions = {}</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { headers = {}, maxRetries = <span class="hljs-number">5</span>, baseDelayMs = <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>, signal, onMessage, onDone } = options;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> lastEventId = options.<span class="hljs-property">lastEventId</span> ?? <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> attempt = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">while</span> (<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>) {
    signal?.<span class="hljs-title function_">throwIfAborted</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">res</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Response</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(url, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'POST'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: { <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'application/json'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Accept</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'text/event-stream'</span>, ...headers },
        <span class="hljs-attr">body</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({ ...(body <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;), ...(lastEventId ? { <span class="hljs-attr">resume_from</span>: lastEventId } : {}) }),
        signal,
      });
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (err <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DOMException</span> &amp;&amp; err.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 用户主动取消，不算失败</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (++attempt &gt; maxRetries) <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> err;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(baseDelayMs * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> ** attempt + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">500</span>, <span class="hljs-number">30000</span>), signal);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>;
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!res.<span class="hljs-property">ok</span> || !res.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (++attempt &gt; maxRetries) <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`stream failed: HTTP <span class="hljs-subst">${res.status}</span>`</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(baseDelayMs * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> ** attempt + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">500</span>, <span class="hljs-number">30000</span>), signal);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>;
    }

    attempt = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 连上一次，清零计数</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> reader = res.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getReader</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> decoder = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">TextDecoder</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (;;) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { done, value } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> reader.<span class="hljs-title function_">read</span>();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (done) <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
        buffer += decoder.<span class="hljs-title function_">decode</span>(value, { <span class="hljs-attr">stream</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> blocks = buffer.<span class="hljs-title function_">split</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'\n\n'</span>);
        buffer = blocks.<span class="hljs-title function_">pop</span>() ?? <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> block <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> blocks) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> msg = <span class="hljs-title function_">parseSSEBlock</span>(block);
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!msg) <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>;
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (msg.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>) lastEventId = msg.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 记住位点，断线从这里续</span>
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (msg.<span class="hljs-property">event</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'done'</span>) {
            onDone?.();
            <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> reader.<span class="hljs-title function_">cancel</span>().<span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>);
            <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
          }
          onMessage?.(msg);
        }
      }
      onDone?.();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 服务端正常关流，结束</span>
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (err <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DOMException</span> &amp;&amp; err.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> reader.<span class="hljs-title function_">cancel</span>().<span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (++attempt &gt; maxRetries) <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> err; <span class="hljs-comment">// 读一半断了，带位点重试</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(baseDelayMs * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> ** attempt + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">500</span>, <span class="hljs-number">30000</span>), signal);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
      reader.<span class="hljs-title function_">releaseLock</span>();
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>用法上配合 <code>AbortController</code> 做取消，组件卸载或用户点停止时直接 <code>abort</code>，不再有幽灵请求：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> controller = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();

<span class="hljs-title function_">streamSSE</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/chat/stream'</span>, { messages }, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: { <span class="hljs-title class_">Authorization</span>: <span class="hljs-string">`Bearer <span class="hljs-subst">${token}</span>`</span> }, <span class="hljs-comment">// 头部鉴权，不拼 URL</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">signal</span>: controller.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">onMessage</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">msg</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">appendToken</span>(msg.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>),
  <span class="hljs-attr">onDone</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setLoading</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>),
}).<span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">err</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (err <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DOMException</span> &amp;&amp; err.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-title function_">toast</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'网络抖动，已自动重试仍失败，请再试一次'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-title function_">report</span>(err); <span class="hljs-comment">// 上报监控，带 lastEventId 便于复盘</span>
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 用户点停止 / 组件卸载</span>
controller.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">讲一讲遇到的一些坑</h3>
<p>客户端写结实了，线上照样可能翻车。下面 👇 四个全是生产里真金白银换来的，每个都给兜底。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-5"><code>Nginx</code> 吞流，首字永远慢</h4>
<p><code>Nginx</code> 默认 <code>proxy_buffering on</code>，会把上游的流攒成块再吐，流式直接退化成轮询。兜底要在 <code>location</code> 里显式关掉，并让上游声明不缓冲：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-nginx" lang="nginx">location /api/chat/stream {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_buffering off;          # 关键：禁止攒批
  proxy_cache off;
  proxy_read_timeout 300s;      # 流式需要长超时
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
}
</code></pre>
<p>服务端再补一个响应头 <code>X-Accel-Buffering: no</code>，双保险。验收标准只有一个：<strong>首字时间</strong>进监控，超过 3 秒直接告警，别等用户投诉🤷‍♂️。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e8a1f47536f7424e8073fb67de7b7f02~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1795403276&amp;x-signature=cF7anVsu%2F5OnXaMYMKGd5WHUkys%3D" alt="连接、去重与保活图解.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">浏览器同域连接上限，<code>SSE</code> 会断开其他请求</h4>
<p><code>HTTP/1.1</code> 下浏览器对同一域名只有 6 个并发连接，<code>SSE</code> 一旦连上就长期占一个。用户开三个问答标签页，再加载页面资源就开始排队，页面转圈的锅最后全算在前端头上。兜底策略：全局限制同页 <code>SSE</code> 并发数为 1，后开的流先 <code>abort</code> 前一个；切 <code>HTTP/2</code> 则多路复用天然缓解，但网关的 <code>stream</code> 并发上限同样要核对，别从浏览器瓶颈换成网关瓶颈👋。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">断线重连导致消息重复</h4>
<p>网络抖动是常态，重连后服务端从 <code>Last-Event-ID</code> 重放，客户端如果直接追加，用户会看到半截回答突然重来一遍。正确做法是<strong>按 <code>ID</code> 去重 + 按位点替换</strong>：维护已收 <code>ID</code> 集合，重放的消息只用于补位不重复渲染；服务端必须保证 <code>ID</code> 单调递增，这是前后端要对齐的契约，不是前端单方面能解决的🫡。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">网关空闲超时切断 和 移动端切后台直接失联</h4>
<p>多数网关默认 60 秒无数据就掐连接，大模型思考超过 60 秒不吐字，连接就被静默掐掉。兜底是服务端每 15 秒发一条注释心跳（<code>:\n\n</code>），既保活又不污染业务流；客户端加一层兜底计时器，30 秒无任何字节就主动重连。同时统计要洗干净：重连次数、首字时间、完整率单独上报，别把重连算进接口成功率里，否则监控一片祥和，线上全是断流。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">什么时候必须换 <code>WebSocket</code></h3>
<p>最后给一张决策表，贴在组里能少吵很多架。出现下面任意一条，<code>SSE</code> 不要硬撑，直接上 <code>WebSocket</code>！</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/bc5fb593b7a4430cbc64d060daf570a3~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1795403276&amp;x-signature=bBddPalN5ARBGwWfg5hgT4VY4kg%3D" alt="WebSocket 与 SSE + fetch 选型决策表.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><code>WebSocket</code> 也不是换过去就完事，心跳、重连退避、<code>token</code> 过期重鉴权，一行都不能少：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// WebSocket 保活与重连骨架：心跳 + 指数退避，token 过期单独处理</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WSOptions</span> {
  heartbeatMs?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  maxRetries?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">getToken</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt;;
  <span class="hljs-attr">onMessage</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">data: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">connectWS</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, options: WSOptions</span>): <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { heartbeatMs = <span class="hljs-number">25000</span>, maxRetries = <span class="hljs-number">8</span>, getToken, onMessage } = options;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ws</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> retries = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">timer</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ReturnType</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">setInterval</span>&gt; | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> closed = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">open</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> token = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getToken</span>();
    ws = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${url}</span>?token=<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-built_in">encodeURIComponent</span>(token)}</span>`</span>);
    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onopen</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> { retries = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; };
    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'string'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'pong'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 心跳回包，直接丢弃</span>
      <span class="hljs-title function_">onMessage</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>);
    };
    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onclose</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (timer) <span class="hljs-built_in">clearInterval</span>(timer);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (closed || ++retries &gt; maxRetries) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(open, <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1000</span> * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> ** retries, <span class="hljs-number">30000</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 退避重连</span>
    };
  };

  timer = <span class="hljs-built_in">setInterval</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ws?.<span class="hljs-property">readyState</span> === <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span>.<span class="hljs-property">OPEN</span>) ws.<span class="hljs-title function_">send</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'ping'</span>);
  }, heartbeatMs);
  <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">open</span>();

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> { closed = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>; <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (timer) <span class="hljs-built_in">clearInterval</span>(timer); ws?.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>(); };
}
</code></pre>
<p>注意 <code>token</code> 过期时不要无脑重连，先刷新 <code>token</code> 再建连，否则重连风暴里全是 <code>401</code>，网关日志会被打爆。</p>
<hr>
<p>流式传输的技术选型，从来都是成本多少的问题。<code>SSE</code> 便宜、简单、和 <code>HTTP</code> 基础设施处得来，配上可取消、可续接的客户端，能覆盖九成 <code>AI</code> 问答场景；<code>WebSocket</code> 留给真正双向的场景。但是别让低频页面替长连接买单！</p>
<p>好了，今天就分享到这里吧🙌</p>
